gateName: SOVRA Phase 15.3 Final Release Gate & Environment Authorization Matrix

local_development.rationale: Single-node test harnesses and simulation drivers operate deterministically with 100% pass rate.

local_loopback_testnet.rationale: Four independent CometBFT nodes running continuously on loopback with synchronized block progression and monetary supply conservation.

validator_transition_activation.rationale: All 14 transition-boundary adversarial tests passed; compromised genesis keys are strictly rejected with ErrRevokedValidator at and above transition height 40,000.

git_history_secret_remediation.rationale: All 5 historical key blobs completely purged on recovery/history-remediation-phase15-3 and pushed to origin. Canonical main branch force-rewrite is withheld pending explicit repository owner authorization to avoid breaking collaborator clones.

hardware_backed_signing.rationale: Physical HSM device is not present in local environment. PKCS#11 specification (AWS CloudHSM SDK 5+ / YubiHSM 2 with CKM_EDDSA) is formally codified, and memory enclave driver is strictly tagged as [DEVELOPMENT_ONLY].

blockingPrerequisites: Provisioning of 4 physical multi-cloud server hosts across independent cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean).
Physical integration of PKCS#11 hardware security modules (AWS CloudHSM SDK 5+ or YubiHSM 2).
mTLS node-to-node P2P transport network configuration across external public IPs.
Repository owner authorization and coordination of the remote Git history rewrite or explicit risk-acceptance.

production_mainnet.rationale: Mainnet authorization is permanently prohibited prior to multi-month live operation on decentralized remote testnet and formal external cryptographic audits.
